nodes.label: SectionConfigOverrides
nodes.rationale: base/global/camera/replay layering lets a section declare common defaults once and only diff the level-specific behavior (e.g. which fields need a restart at global vs camera level).

nodes.label: MessageConditionContext
nodes.rationale: Condition functions get both saved config (fullConfig/fullCameraConfig) and in-flight formData so a message can compare a pending edit against what is already persisted (e.g. detect aspect-ratio mismatch).

nodes.label: SectionConfigOverrides
nodes.rationale: One config module per Frigate config section, split into base plus per-level partial overrides (global, camera, replay), so shared form metadata is declared once and only the deltas per rendering level are restated.

nodes.label: ConditionalMessage
nodes.rationale: Messages carry a translation key rather than literal text, and a `key` used for React list rendering and dedup, so section-level warnings stay i18n-compliant and stable across re-renders.

nodes.label: MessageConditionContext
nodes.rationale: Condition functions receive the whole FrigateConfig, the camera config, the level, and live formData so a message can react to cross-section state (e.g. record disabled) as well as unsaved edits.

nodes.label: restartRequired Field Marking
nodes.rationale: Fields listed here cannot be hot-reloaded by the Frigate backend, so the form must warn the user a restart is needed; the list differs per level because some values only bind at process startup.

nodes.label: advancedFields Progressive Disclosure
nodes.rationale: Tuning knobs that most users should never touch are hidden behind an advanced toggle instead of removed, keeping the default form approachable without losing power-user access.

nodes.label: hiddenFields Suppression
nodes.rationale: Backend-derived fields (enabled_in_config, raw_mask, mask) are present in the Pydantic-generated schema but are not user-editable, so every section hides them rather than the schema omitting them.

nodes.label: uiSchema Custom Widget Mapping
nodes.rationale: RJSF widget names (zoneNames, objectLabels, password, ptzPresets, timezoneSelect) are declared per field so the generic schema-driven form can render domain-aware pickers without special-casing sections in component code.

nodes.label: suppressMultiSchema UI Option
nodes.rationale: Pydantic Optional/Union fields generate anyOf schemas that RJSF renders as a type selector; suppressMultiSchema collapses that into a single control so users see one input, not a schema picker.

nodes.label: ui:before / ui:after Custom Render Slots
nodes.rationale: Sections that need bespoke UI (notifications registration, semantic search reindex, proxy role map, review status toggles) inject a named React component into the generated form instead of forking the form renderer.

nodes.label: Cross-Section Dependency Warning Pattern
nodes.rationale: Frigate sections are interdependent (objects/snapshots/review need detect enabled; review and genai need record enabled). Rather than blocking edits, each dependent section declares a condition over the full config and renders an info/warning message so the user learns the setting will be inert.
